BYD Denza Z9 GT India Launch Price Rs 1.57 Cr - 670 km Range, 270 km/h Topspeed

KS
By Kabir Sharma Indian Automotive & SUV Specialist • via Rushlane.com Wire
⚡ Visual Story
Source & Photography: Rushlane.com Wire Dispatch Verified Editorial Asset
⚡ Executive Takeaways & Key Highlights
  • BYD has launched Denza Z9 GT in India today for a price tag of Rs 1.57 Crores (Ex-sh).
  • The shooting brake is the performance flagship of BYD’s luxury brand and arrives in a market where most premium electric offerings take the form of SUVs or sedans.
  • Official reporting verified via Rushlane.com news desk.
⚡ EDITORIAL TAKE • KABIR SHARMA Indian Automotive & SUV Specialist

Bharat NCAP Safety Standards & Indian Road Readiness

In India's rapidly evolving automotive landscape, crashworthiness and real-world durability are driving consumer purchase decisions like never before. As reported by Rushlane.com, indigenous automakers like Tata Motors and Mahindra are setting global safety benchmarks while optimizing suspension and ground clearance for unpredictable road conditions.

Big Picture: Upcoming monthly FADA retail delivery reports and Bharat NCAP rating scorecards will reveal which domestic models capture mass-market dominance.

BYD has launched Denza Z9 GT in India today for a price tag of Rs 1.57 Crores (Ex-sh). The shooting brake is the performance flagship of BYD’s luxury brand and arrives in a market where most premium electric offerings take the form of SUVs or sedans. There are three exterior colour options to choose from – Fjord Green, Obsidian Black and Rime Gold. Then there are three interior colour theme options too – Dark Chocolate + Perg Beige, Dark Chocolate + Red Velvet and Full Black.

📌 The Core Development

Reservations start today for a nominal price of Rs 10 lakh and is offered in six cities only – Mumbai, Gurugram, Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Chennai and Hyderabad. Denza is bundling 6 years or 1,50,000 km vehicle warranty and 8 years or 1,60,000 HV battery warranty. Also, there is a reservation policy where BYD is offering complimentary 6 years RSA and 11 kW home charging.

The India-spec Denza Z9 GT combines a long bonnet and low roofline with a rear hatch and a five-seat cabin. It measures around 5,180 in length and 1,990 mm in width, with a 3,125 mm wheelbase. Dual-bar headlamps, flush door handles, a split roof spoiler, wraparound tail lamps and a prominent rear diffuser are among its distinguishing features.

🔍 Background & Sector Context

Rear-wheel steering is one of the Z9 GT’s more unusual features. On suitably equipped versions, the rear wheels can steer independently, enabling manoeuvres such as crab walking. That hardware also has an everyday use on a car of this size, helping it manoeuvre in tighter spaces

Inside, Denza Z9 GT gets a 17.3-inch central touchscreen, a 13.2-inch digital instrument cluster and a separate 13.2-inch screen for the front passenger. Denza also offers an augmented-reality head-up display, 20-speaker Devialet audio system, knitted velvet headliner, a panoramic glass roof, dual 50 W wireless charging pads and more. The seats offer power adjustment, heating, ventilation and massage as well.

📊 Industry & Real-World Impact

India-spec Denza Z9 GT gets the fully electric powertrain with BYD’s 2nd Gen Blade battery tech. The total capacity is 122.49 kWh and it sends juice to a three-motor setup. Front motor has 308 bhp and 410 Nm and rear gets two 416 bhp and 400 Nm electric motors. Denza quotes a 0–100 km/h time of 2.7 seconds, top speed of 270 km/h and up to 670 km of driving range (NEDC).

🔮 Strategic Outlook & What Lies Ahead

Front tyres are 255/45-R20 and rear tyres are much fatter 275/40-R20. There’s DiSus-A suspension system along with sophisticated ADAS suite with a host of autonomous driving features. The Z9 GT is part of Denza’s initial India rollout through fully built imports and dedicated showrooms. Its shooting brake body gives it a distinct place in the lineup, combining a long-roof profile and rear hatch with the performance hardware of a flagship grand tourer.
